title: Interactive DC Art Discover Stories Behind the Masterpieces Tour
includes: Real Discussions That Make Art Come To Life
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Engage with art in a whole new way on this interactive tour inside the National Gallery of Art. Delve into fascinating stories behind renowned pieces, like the only Da Vinci in the Americas, and uncover the rivalries, scandals, and personal tales that shaped the art world. Designed for families and those curious about art, this tour adapts to your group's interests and pace for a relaxed, enjoyable experience. Enjoy a fully conversational format that skips the dry academic approach and makes art more relatable and intriguing.

- Visit the National Gallery of Art with expert-led storytelling
- Adaptable pacing to fit your group's energy and curiosity
- Perfect for families looking to engage kids in art without pressure
- Explore significant art history moments, like Van Gogh's rivalry with Gauguin
